description: This Java source file defines the OptionsController class in a Spring MVC web application, managing CRUD operations for product options in an e-commerce backend. It handles displaying, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting product options, interacting with services and models related to product options and merchant stores.

classes.name: OptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing product options in the admin backend, enabling listing, editing, creation, saving, pagination, and deletion of product options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of product options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the editing form for an existing product option identified by ID.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Common method to handle displaying the product option form for both creating new and editing existing options.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product option, including validation and form processing.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to retrieve paginated list of product options in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to delete a specified product option.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set menu attributes in the model for UI navigation.
